stem_book: The mechanism shown in figure is used to raise a wooden box of mass 50 kg. A string is wrapped around a cylinder that turns on an axle. The cylinder has radius 0.25 m and moment of inertia 0.92 kg m² about the axle. The force F is applied tangentially to the rotating crank handle, at a distance 0.12 m from the axle. What magnitude of the force F is required to raise the box with an acceleration of 0.80 m/s²? Neglect the moment of inertia of the axle and the crank. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
correct_answer: F ≈ 1.13 × 10³ N (printed key 1100 N = same to 2 s.f.)
reason: crank radius 0.12 m only in figure, g = 9.8 added (Sears-Zemansky original); printed key 1100 N is 1129 N rounded to 2 s.f. - not an error
